subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin decided the necromantic pearl was necromantic, based on its sensation, like the smell from a giant's larder.
source_quote: I decided, necromantic, the same way you decide the smell coming from the back of a giant's larder means something died in there a while ago.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intended to take the necromantic pearl because he would not leave anything useful in the cavern.
source_quote: I didn't need a name for it. It was worth something to the right buyer, and I was not going to leave anything useful in this cavern, so I pocketed it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt the bundle of ritual items was not equipment but evidence of Ilvara's madness.
source_quote: It wasn't equipment. It was evidence. It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin refused to pray over the dead soldiers of House Mizzrym because he had nothing to say to them.
source_quote: I didn't pray over them. They'd come here doing what they were told by someone who had already lost her mind, and I had nothing to say to them that wasn't just 'better luck in another life.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the signet ring and documents proved House T'sarran had contracted to extract Daz alive.
source_quote: The documents were worse. What was left of them... confirmed what we'd been trying to piece together since the mage had arrived with her mercenary escort. There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin considered Daz’s response to Nym’s skepticism to be the most restrained thing he could have said.
source_quote: Daz looked at her with something behind his eyes that I couldn't quite read. He let a beat pass, and then he said: 'So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?' Which was, I thought, the most restrained thing he could possibly have said in that moment.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understood the necromantic pearl was not in the wrong place by accident — someone had placed it there.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembered Ilvara taking his tooth at Velkynvelve as a trophy and a symbol of power.
source_quote: When we'd first found ourselves hanging in nets at Velkynvelve, Ilvara had made a point of collecting trophies. It was the kind of thing a person does when they want their captives to understand the power relation clearly — she'd taken my tooth.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt the debt of his stolen tooth was now settled because he had recovered it.
source_quote: It was settled now. I had the tooth back.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intended to keep silent about the significance of the tooth and the pearl because speaking would add nothing to the next ten seconds.
source_quote: I didn't say any of that out loud. Thorin Giantfriend, radical transparency, except when the thing being said wouldn't add anything to the next ten seconds.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wondered why powerful Drow houses would spend so much to extract him, given his lack of consequence.
source_quote: I am not, by any meaningful measure, a person of consequence. I am a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan... My lineage is not distinguished. My House, if I ever truly had one, is not significant. I do not possess anything worth this level of orchestrated attention.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz privately catalogued the possibility of noble blood as embarrassing and preferred a more interesting answer.
source_quote: I have, privately, catalogued that possibility and found it embarrassing. Whatever the answer to this question turns out to be, I prefer it to be something more interesting than inherited blood I didn't earn.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz resolved to investigate his origins together with the party and split any proceeds from the discovery.
source_quote: I think,' I said, keeping my voice very even, 'that we should investigate this together. Whatever we find — whoever is behind this, whatever they think I'm worth — we split the proceeds.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Nym and Kaelira regarded him with skepticism that was precise, not cruel.
source_quote: Nym and Kaelira regarded me with the specific expression that Drow reserve for people they find simultaneously interesting and beneath consideration. The tone was sardonic in the way that only people trained in the same school of thought as me can manage — not cruel, just precise.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz accepted that the Duskryn sisters were not entirely wrong to be skeptical of his possible noble lineage.
source_quote: The uncomfortable truth is that they were not entirely wrong to be skeptical.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz filed the question of his identity away to return to it at inconvenient moments.
source_quote: I filed the question where I file most things that don't have immediate answers — in the part of my mind that I return to at inconvenient moments — and let the conversation move on.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that Dawnbringer refused to be used as a religious symbol for purification.
source_quote: I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things. I will not be treated like a religious symbol to be used and waved over corrupt—

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Thorin’s use of the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard was an effective tool for negotiating with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: I noted the outburst, noted Thorin's expression — the particular patience of a man who has had this conversation before and expects to have it again — and watched.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized that Thorin and Dawnbringer’s exchange had the comfortable rhythm of repetition — they had been here before.
source_quote: They had been here before, the dwarf and his sword. They would be here again.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz acknowledged that he carried unresolved questions about his identity alongside the party’s other burdens.
source_quote: I had an unanswered question about my own identity sitting unresolved in my chest, a pair of Drow mercenaries who found me either fascinating or ridiculous, and a sunblade that had just been persuaded to participate in something it found philosophically objectionable.

subject: Daz's identity
fact: Daz intends to uncover the truth about why he was targeted, even if the answer is not noble blood.
source_quote: Whatever the answer to this question turns out to be, I prefer it to be something more interesting than inherited blood I didn't earn.

subject: The necromantic pearl
fact: Thorin suspects the pearl is a key to understanding Ilvara’s ritual corruption, but has not yet named its origin.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it. Either answer was a problem that needed a name.

subject: The stolen tooth
fact: Thorin carries the recovered tooth as a symbol of closure from his captivity at Velkynvelve.
source_quote: It was settled now. I had the tooth back.
